Profile B (Law, Psychology, History, Philosophy, Veterinary Science): IELTS 7.0 with 7.0 in writing and 6.5 in all other skills; IB A: Literature 6 SL or 5 HL / A: Literature and Language 6 SL or 5 HL / B 7 SL or 6 HL. Profile A (Medicine, Dentistry, English BA): IELTS 7.5 with 7.0 in all skills; IB A: Literature 6 SL or HL / A: Literature and Language 7 SL or 6 HL / B 7 at HL. Profile G (Economics, Economics and Finance, Economics and Mathematics, Accounting and Finance, International Business Management): IELTS 6.5 with 7.0 in reading and listening, no score below 6.0; IB A: Literature 5 SL or HL / A: Literature and Language 6 SL or 5 HL / B 7 SL or 6 HL. UCAS 2027-entry deadline for Medicine (A100) and Dentistry (A200): Thursday 15 October 2026. name: University of Southampton
living_cost_source: https://www.southampton.ac.uk/student-life/living-costs (Southampton Student living costs page: 'Your biggest weekly cost will be your accommodation. University of Southampton managed Halls of Residence include utilities and a Unilink bus pass in their cost.' Weekly averages — Accommodation in University Halls GBP 155 to 236 (utilities+bus included); Private rent GBP 115; Utilities GBP 30; Wi-Fi GBP 4; Phone GBP 10; Unilink bus pass GBP 9 (included in Halls rent); Other transport GBP 15; Food shopping GBP 50; Social and wellbeing GBP 30; Clothing and personal care GBP 20; Trips and opportunities GBP 25; Books and other course costs GBP 14; Laundry costs GBP 5. Page describes Southampton cost of living as 'relatively low compared to other Russell Group university cities across the UK.')
baseline_requirement: Southampton does not publish a single blanket IB Diploma minimum; entry requirements are stated per course page as a total Diploma points score plus a Higher Level slip (e.g. Archaeology BA 'Pass, with overall score of 30 points with 15 points at Higher Level'; Computer Science BSc 'Pass, with 34 points overall, with 17 points required at Higher Level including 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation'; Electronic/Electrical/Mechanical/Aeronautics and Astronautics/Civil/Biomedical Engineering MEng 'Pass, with 38 points overall with 19 points required at Higher Level, including 6 at Higher Level in Physics (or Biology/Chemistry/Computer Science) and 6 at Higher Level in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation'; Medicine BM5 BMBS 'Overall score of 36 points with 18 at Higher Level, with 6 in Biology and one additional Science'). Southampton accepts both Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches (HL) and Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation (HL) for all IB-relevant undergraduate courses (per course page IB Diploma entries); Analysis and Approaches is preferred for many Engineering/CS/Maths/Physics courses; Acoustical Engineering MEng explicitly asks either 6 at HL in AA or 7 at HL in AI. Applicants without the required HL subjects can apply for the Engineering/Physics/Mathematics Foundation Year. GCSE English Language (or GCSE English) plus GCSE Mathematics at grade 4/C or above is typically required, or an equivalent (course page 'Most courses require GCSE English Language (or GCSE English) and GCSE Mathematics at grade 4/C or above, or an equivalent qualification accepted by the University'). IB Career-Related Programme (IBCP) accepted — 'Offers will be made on the individual Diploma Course subject(s) and the career-related study qualification. The CP core will not form part of the offer.' Contextual offers available for eligible Home applicants ('Applicants who are highlighted in this way will be made an offer which is lower than the typical offer for that programme'). Home tuition fee is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 per year (course pages 'UK students pay GBP 10,050'; Southampton Tuition fees, funding and scholarships undergraduate page).
english_requirement_default: Standard Southampton undergraduate band is IELTS Academic overall score 6.5 with minimum 6.0 in reading, 6.0 in writing, 6.0 in speaking and 6.0 in listening (course pages 'IELTS score requirements': overall 6.5 / reading 6.0 / writing 6.0 / speaking 6.0 / listening 6.0). Law LLB requires IELTS overall 6.5 with minimum 6.5 in each component (Law LLB course page IELTS score requirements). Medicine BM5 BMBS requires IELTS overall 7.0 with minimum 7.0 in each component (Medicine BM5 course page IELTS score requirements). Pre-sessional English programmes offered where the IELTS requirement is not met (course pages: 'If you do not meet the English language requirements through a test or qualification, you may be able to meet them by completing one of our pre-sessional English programmes before your course starts'). English language equivalency routes (TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, Cambridge English, etc.) and IB-based English equivalencies live on Southampton's English language requirements pages (https://www.southampton.ac.uk/international/english-language-requirements).
admission_default: All full-time undergraduate applications are made through UCAS; University of Southampton UCAS institution code S27 (code name SOTON; Southampton Apply through UCAS page). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline Wednesday 13 January 2027 (UCAS Dates and deadlines page: '(18:00 UK time) Equal consideration date for applications for most undergraduate courses'). Medicine BM5 (A100) UCAS deadline Thursday 15 October 2026 (UCAS Dates and deadlines page: '(18:00 UK time) Equal consideration date for applications to the universities of Oxford and Cambridge, and for most courses in medicine, dentistry, and veterinary medicine/science'; BM5 course page: 'All applicants must sit the UCAT test before the 15th October UCAS deadline'). UCAS applications open for 2027 entry in September 2026. Selection: UCAT required for Medicine BM5 with ranking to interview (BM5 course page 'Selection to Interview: All applicants who meet the entry requirements through either achieved or predicted grades at the point of application are ranked by UCAT score and the top number of applicants invited to interview'); portfolio is required for art courses only (Southampton Apply through UCAS page: 'you may also be asked to submit a portfolio. This is typically for Arts courses such as: BA Hons Graphic Arts, BA Fine Art, BA Games, Design and Art'); LNAT (Law National Aptitude Test) is NOT required for Southampton Law LLB (Law LLB course page Non-academic entry requirements: 'LNAT is not required for our programmes'). Age requirement: applicants must be 18 or over at the start of Medicine BM5 (course page 'Applicants must be 18 or over at the start of the course'). Physics BSc/MPhys applicants may be invited for an optional departmental interview which may lower the offer (Physics course pages 'The optional interview may lead to a lower offer'). Home tuition 2027/28: GBP 10,050 per year. International 2027/28 per-year rates printed per course: GBP 27,500 (English BA, Two Modern Languages BA); GBP 28,300 (Archaeology BA, History BA, Economics BSc, Economics and Actuarial Science BSc, Business Management BSc, Accounting and Finance BSc); GBP 28,400 (Law LLB); GBP 29,000 (Film Studies BA); GBP 29,800 (Mathematics BSc, Mathematics with Actuarial Science BSc); GBP 31,000 (Biomedical Engineering MEng); GBP 33,000 (Computer Science BSc, Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence MEng, Software Engineering MEng); GBP 33,500 (Electronic/Electrical/Mechanical/Aeronautics and Astronautics/Civil/Maritime/Acoustical Engineering MEng); GBP 33,900 (Biology BSc, Biomedical Sciences BSc, Neuroscience BSc, Psychology BSc, Oceanography BSc, Physical Geography BSc); GBP 34,100 (Physics BSc, Physics MPhys, Chemistry BSc, Chemistry MChem); Medicine BM5 BMBS international GBP 35,900 per year.

name: The University of Sheffield
living_cost_source: https://www.sheffield.ac.uk/accommodation/rents (Sheffield Rents 2026/27 page: Undergraduate self-catered University accommodation, 42-week contract. Weekly rent GBP 151.41 (Crescent Flats Shared Bathroom, City) up to GBP 240.38 (Laddow Studios Studio, 51-week contract). Ranmoor and Endcliffe En-suite apartments GBP 195.72 / Deluxe GBP 212.17 / Studio GBP 227.68 weekly. Rent covers utility bills, contents insurance and internet access plus access to Residence Life events and sports. Save the Student National Student Money Survey averages highlighted on the Sheffield Living Costs page: Groceries GBP 155/month, Transport GBP 73/month, Going out GBP 60/month, Takeaways/eating out GBP 45/month, Clothes/shopping GBP 33/month, Mobile phone GBP 15/month, Subscriptions GBP 14/month.)
baseline_requirement: Sheffield publishes an IB Diploma offer per course, stated as an overall Diploma points score plus a Higher Level slip (e.g. Computer Science BSc IB Diploma: '36, with 6 in HL Maths; 34, with 6 in HL Maths, and A in the Extended Essay; 34, with 6 in HL Maths and 5 in HL Computer Science'; A Level AAA including Maths / AAB including A in Maths and B in Computer Science). The standard typical-offer headline is usually one or two points above the alternative one which is conditional on grade A in the Extended Essay (or equivalent). Examples (2027 entry): Computer Science / Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) BSc IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (or 34 with 6 in HL Maths + A in EE, or + 5 in HL CS); Mathematics BSc and Financial Mathematics BSc IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (Analysis and Approaches) (or 34 with 6 in HL Maths AA + A in EE); Physics BSc IB 34 with 6,5 (in any order) in HL Maths and Physics (or 33 with 5 in HL Maths and Physics + B in EE); Physics MPhys IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths and Physics (or 34 with 6,5 + A in EE); Chemistry BSc / Chemistry MChem IB 34 with 5 in HL Chemistry (or 33 + B in EE); Biological Sciences BSc IB 34 with 6,5 in HL Biology and a second science (or 33 + A in a science-based EE); Biomedical Science BSc IB 34 with 6,5 in two HL science subjects; Psychology BSc IB 34 with 5 in a HL science subject; Data Science BSc IB 34 (or 33 with A in a science-based EE); Economics BSc IB 34 with 5 in HL Maths (or 33 + B in EE); Business Management BA / Accounting and Financial Management BA IB 34 (or 33 with A in the EE); Law LLB IB 36 (or 34 with A in the EE); Medicine MBChB IB 36 with 6 in three HL subjects including Chemistry or Biology and a second science, and no less than 4 in all SL subjects; Dental Surgery BDS IB 36 with 6 in HL Chemistry and Biology; Nursing (Adult) BMedSci IB 32; Mechanical / Aerospace Engineering MEng IB 38 with 6 in HL Maths and at least one of Physics/Chemistry/Biology (or 36 with + A in a science-based EE for Mechanical); Civil and Structural / Electrical and Electronic / Chemical / Materials Science and Engineering / Mechatronic and Robotic Engineering MEng IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths (or 34 with 6,5 in HL Maths and a science + A/B in the EE); Architecture BA IB 36 (or 34 + A in the EE) plus portfolio and GCSE Maths grade 4/C; Landscape Architecture BA IB 33 (or 32 with B in the EE) plus portfolio; Journalism Studies BA IB 33 (or 32 with B in the EE); Digital Media and Society / Sociology BA IB 33 (or 32 with B in the EE); Politics and International Relations / Criminology BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); Geography BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); Urban Studies and Planning MPlan(UG) IB 33 (or 32 with B in a social-science based EE) plus GCSE Maths grade 4/C; English Literature BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); History BA and Philosophy BA IB 34 (or 33 with B in the EE); Modern Languages and Cultures BA IB 33 typically with 5 in a HL modern foreign language (or 32 with B in the EE). Where IB offers are a range, the lower bound is conditional on the Extended Essay / additional HL grade as stated on the course page. GCSE English Language and GCSE Maths grade 4/C or above (some courses higher) are typically required; many Engineering and Psychology courses require GCSE Maths grade 6/B or 5/B. Home tuition fee is the published 2027/28 rate GBP 10,050 per year (Sheffield Undergraduate tuition fees 2027 page: 'The standard annual undergraduate tuition fee for home fee-paying students starting their course in 2027 is GBP 10,050').
english_requirement_default: Standard Sheffield undergraduate band is IELTS Academic grade of 6.5 with a minimum of 6.0 in each component plus GCSE English Language at grade 4/C (most course pages 'For this course we require: GCSE English Language at grade 4/C; IELTS grade of 6.5 with a minimum of 6.0 in each component'). Law LLB, English Literature BA and Modern Languages and Cultures BA require IELTS 7.0 with minimum 6.5 in each component. Journalism Studies BA and Medicine MBChB require IELTS 7.5 with minimum 7.0 in each component; Medicine also requires GCSE English Language at grade 6/B. Dental Surgery BDS requires IELTS 7.0 with minimum 6.5 in each component plus GCSE English Language at grade 7/A. Nursing (Adult) BMedSci requires IELTS 7.0 with minimum 7.0 in Speaking, Reading and Listening, and 6.5 in Writing, plus GCSE English Language grade 4/C. IB English equivalencies on Sheffield English language requirements for undergraduates page: 'International Baccalaureate (IB) Standard or Higher Level English A: Language and Literature Grade 4 or above; IB Standard or Higher Level English A: Literature Grade 4 or above; IB Standard Level English B Grade 6 or above; IB Higher Level English B Grade 5 or above.' Alternatives: TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE Academic, Cambridge C1 Advanced, Oxford ELLT, LanguageCert Academic SELT, Trinity ISE III/IV; pre-sessional English at the University ELTC and International Foundation Year / International Year One at the University of Sheffield International College meet the requirement.
admission_default: Applications for full-time undergraduate courses are made through UCAS; University of Sheffield UCAS institution code S18 (code name SHEFD; Sheffield Undergraduate Apply page). UCAS 2027-entry equal consideration deadline Wednesday 13 January 2027 for all courses except Medicine and Dentistry (Sheffield Undergraduate Applying essentials page: 'Applications for courses starting in September 2027 (except Medicine and Dentistry) should be submitted to UCAS between: 1 September 2026 and 13 January 2027 to be guaranteed equal consideration'; 'Applications for places on Medicine and Dentistry courses must be submitted between 1 September and 15 October 2026'). UCAS applications open for 2027 entry in September 2026. Medicine (A100) and Dentistry (A200) UCAS 2027-entry deadline Thursday 15 October 2026. UCAT (University Clinical Aptitude Test) taken in the year of application required for Medicine MBChB and Dental Surgery BDS; Medicine selection also includes an interview stage; Dental Surgery mentions UCAT used in conjunction with the existing selection procedure. LNAT (Law National Aptitude Test) is NOT listed in the Sheffield Law LLB course page Other requirements. Portfolio of artistic ability required for Architecture BA and Landscape Architecture BA. STEP, STEP 2 or STEP 3 at grade 3 or above gives additional consideration for Mathematics BSc but is not considered in place of a third A Level. GCSE English Language 4/C and GCSE Maths 4/C typical (some courses higher: Medicine and Dentistry GCSE English 7/A or 6/B, many Engineering courses GCSE Maths 6/B, Psychology BSc GCSE Maths 5/B, Business Management BA and Accounting and Financial Management BA GCSE Maths 6/B, Civil and Structural Engineering MEng GCSE Physics 6/B, Materials Science and Engineering MEng GCSE Maths 6/B and 4/C in Physics and Chemistry, Urban Studies and Planning MPlan GCSE Maths 4/C). Contextual offers via Access Sheffield equivalent to one or two grades below the standard A Level requirements. Home tuition 2027/28: GBP 10,050 per year. International per-year tuition printed on each course fee lookup for 2027-28 (e.g. GBP 27,650 Business Management BA; GBP 29,570 Law LLB, Data Science BSc, Geography BA, Urban Planning MPlan, Journalism Studies BA; GBP 32,340 Mathematics BSc, Financial Mathematics BSc; GBP 34,670 Computer Science BSc, Computer Science (AI), Physics BSc/MPhys, Chemistry BSc/MChem, Biological Sciences BSc, Biomedical Science BSc, Psychology BSc, all Engineering MEng, Architecture BA; GBP 51,380 per year Medicine MBChB; GBP 55,000 per year Dental Surgery BDS). International (overseas) fee NOT printed on the course fee lookup for Nursing (Adult) BMedSci (overseas=null on the 2027 fee API). Sheffield offers a fixed-fee guarantee for international students on courses longer than one year: 'International students will pay the same fixed annual tuition fee for each year of the same course.'
